question: Which museum lies closest ahead of Bastion Studios, Erie, PA toward Jakes Rock Overlook and Mountain Bike Trail, Tidioute, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.078195 42.115808)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.348409 41.636215)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.078195 42.115808)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.078195 42.115808)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: Jakes Rock Overlook and Mountain Bike Trail, Tidioute, PA

poi.poi_name: Jakes Rock Overlook and Mountain Bike Trail
